title: Mixed Event — Wonder Magical Showtime! — Episode6 The Smiling Sorcerer

meta.Event Outline: Phoenix Wonderland is faced with a transformation at the hands of Emu's brothers to appeal to the young adult crowd. In order to make sure it stays a place that makes everyone smile, Wonderlands×Showtime prepares a new show. In time, the curtain rises on a show unlike any other!

rows.Line: Outside the Neo Phoenix Castle

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: It's just an open plaza. They're really gonna do a show here?

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: I know about all the stages they have here, but I didn't know that they could do shows here too...

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Yes, I can't wait to see what they have in store for us! I can never get enough of this anticipation before the curtains go up!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: (Just what exactly do they plan on doing...?)

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “Are you here to see the show?”

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
What the...?!
That robot just talked!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Oh, this is just marvelous!
Using autonomous robots as park staff...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What? Um, yes, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: “We ask that you please put on these bracelets if you wish to see the show.”

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Bracelets...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It feels like plastic... Maybe they glow in the dark or... Hm? There's something inside...?

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Wonderful! It's all about to start...!
se_event_wonders_2021_003
“Hah hah hah hah!”

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What the...?!

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “I am the great sorcerer, Miles! My magic will spread far and wide, and make everything in this world shine!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Excellent! A great self introduction if I don't say so myself! It is only a matter of time now until someone calls me forth!”
“Just who do you expect to call you forth in a place like this, master...?”

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Is that...Emu?!
And he's from the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Wah! Don't scare me like that! How long have you been standing there, Shao?!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Before you started laughing. And how many times do I have to say this?! You're the one that scares me every time you do that!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “But laughing is a good thing. You should be doing the same, Shao, since you're still just a child. You won't be able to become a sorcerer if you keep pouting like that.”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“I'm not a child!
I'm twelve years old!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “And I'm pouting because you've never shown me how to do any magic, master!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “I'm starting to wonder if you really are as great a sorcerer as you say you are. I haven't even seen you perform a single spell.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“Hahaha! My apologies!
I'm of the mind that having fun is more important than magic is all!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “My goal is to 'live a fun life' and always place that above everything else!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “That just means you're just some kind of charlatan instead of a sorcerer...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “But it seems the time has come for you to see some magic!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “What?! Really?!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Yes, right here!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “So that's why you brought me out to this burned field! You're about to perform a really big spell!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “But this place really is empty, isn't it...?”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “It used to be so vibrant and full of natural beauty. I even came to visit pretty often... Until that big war happened...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “No, that will not do. Such melancholy! There is no fun in that whatsoever!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Tell me, Shao. What was your favorite part about this place?”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Huh? Um...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “There used to be this really, really big tree at the center of town. When you climbed to the very top, you could see everything for miles and miles...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“Yes, I see!
We can take that thought and...
There...!!”

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: Huh?! Whoa! Look at the Ferris wheel!

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: It's so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: This is...!!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: He lit up the Ferris wheel with his spell...?

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“No way!
W-What is that thing?! It looks like a big windmill!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Hahaha! It's an observation platform of my own design and you should be able to 'see everything for miles and miles'...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“That's amazing...!
Master, you really are a great sorcerer! I was convinced that you were just a really weird person!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “What do you mean by that last part?!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“Anyways, this is how you use magic.
It's going to take you years to learn how to do this, but are you still willing to give it a try...?”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Yes! Please, teach me...!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Who are you...?”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“Huh?!
M-Master, it's a little girl...!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “You're right. Do you think she's from that village over there?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Have either of you seen a pony around here?”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “A pony?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “It's white and means everything to me, but we got separated during the war...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Where could it have gone...? Maybe mom was right. Maybe it's already...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Master...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “No, this isn't right. She should be having fun...!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“Hello there.
Your pony actually asked us to do something for you.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “There...!!”

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line:
Look!
The merry-go-round started moving and it's all lit up!

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: That's awesome!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “These toy ponies... They look like mine...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Your pony's gone off to a far away place, but wanted you to not feel sad and asked us to do this...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Is it okay if I try riding on one...?”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Yes, of course! Right this way!”

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: They're making an amusement park for all the people that lost so much because of the war, including their precious smiles.

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: That reminds me. Rakunosuke told me about how he built this park for the same reason.

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Wave...! Wave...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“No... Why isn't anything happening...?
I thought I learned how to do this one...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“Hahaha! That's because I'm a genius!
But you too will be able to cast this spell once you've learned its secret, Shao!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Hm? Is someone else coming...?”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “I think it's an old man this time.”

rows.Speaker: Elderly Person
rows.Line:
“Who are you...?
What are you doing here?”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Uh oh. This could be bad...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line:
“Hello sir.
We're sorcerers in the middle of practicing our magical arts.”

rows.Speaker: Elderly Person
rows.Line:
“Sorcerers?
Hmph... Take this as a warning. Don't come near our village.”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “What?”

rows.Speaker: Elderly Person
rows.Line: “That war turned this entire place upside down and everyone's still on edge about it. They don't take too kindly to outsiders now.”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “I see... Thank you for telling us. By the way, sir, is there anything you'd like to see or have?”

rows.Speaker: Elderly Person
rows.Line: “What...?”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “I'd like to present you with a gift that you'll enjoy! I am a sorcerer after all!”

rows.Speaker: Elderly Person
rows.Line: “Fine. Then, give me a train. One that can take me to the harbor each month. I like the way it rocks me to sleep during the way...”

rows.Speaker: Elderly Person
rows.Line: “But all the tracks are gone and riding on anything like that is beyond my wildest dreams now...”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Hah hah hah! That will not be an issue! And once won't feel like enough so...!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “Here...!”
se_event_wonders_2021_008

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: “Ah, he made the park train with his last spell! That is a popular one among us older folk!”

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: “Its rails have all been lit up as if they've somehow been enchanted...!”

rows.Speaker: Elderly Person
rows.Line:
“W-What is the meaning of this...?!
I've never seen a train like this before!”

rows.Speaker: Miles
rows.Line: “It isn't able to go very far, but its track forms one, big loop, so you'll be able to ride it for as long as you like...!”

rows.Speaker: Elderly Person
rows.Line: “Haha. You're quite a curious fellow...”

rows.Speaker: Elderly Person
rows.Line: “And it seems like you're not a bad sorcerer either...”
se_event_wonders_2021_008

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line:
Hehe. What will he do next?
I can't wait...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Uh, yes!
I'm glad that you're enjoying our wonderful show!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Father
rows.Line: He's just like him...
